test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: maths
question: The compound interest (compounding annually) on a certain sum at the rate of 8 percent per annum for two years is Rs. 6656. What would be the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate of interest for two years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of CI for 2 years = R + R + (R × R) / 100 = 8 + 8 + (8 × 8) / 100 = 16.64%

Effective rate of SI for 2 years = R × T = 8 × 2 = 16%

Given: 16.64% of Sum = Rs. 6656

Required: 16% of Sum = (6656 ÷ 16.64) × 16 = 400 × 16 = 6400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Compound Interest (CI) = Rs. 6656

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula:**

CI = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e52eab10af67df105cbe3b976d0d496ffb99daa21fc64073bd2dbe4ce9b59932.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 6656 = P[(1 + 8/100)² − 1]

⇒ 6656 = P[(108/100)² − 1]

⇒ 6656 = P[(27/25)² − 1]

⇒ 6656 = P[729/625 − 1]

⇒ 6656 = P[(729 − 625) ÷ 625]

⇒ 6656 = P × (104 ÷ 625)

⇒ P = (6656 × 625) ÷ 104

⇒ P = 64 × 625

⇒ P = Rs. 40000

Now, calculate SI on the same sum:

⇒ SI = (40000 × 8 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 400 × 16

⇒ SI = Rs. 6400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

The difference (D) between CI and SI for a period of 2 years is given by D = P(R/100)².

Relation between CI and SI for 2 years

CI = SI × (1 + R/200) or SI = CI × [200 ÷ (200 + R)]. For 2 years, CI is always greater than or equal to SI.

Effective Rate of Interest

For Compound Interest, the effective rate for n years can be calculated using successive percentage formula: rₑff = x + y + (xy/100).</p
